lanes.label: Version 2 · real-world setting
lanes.stem: During a quality control check, two independent automated sensors (Sensor A and Sensor B) each randomly assign a severity rating from 1 to 4 with equal probability. Sensor A also logs the ambient temperature (22°C). What is the probability that the sum of the ratings from the two sensors equals 5?

lanes.label: Version 3 · what-if
lanes.stem: When rolling two standard fair 6-sided dice, 6 of the 36 possible outcomes yield a sum of 7, giving a probability of 1/6. Suppose the second die is replaced with a custom fair die whose faces are all doubled, displaying numbers {2, 4, 6, 8, 10, 12} instead of {1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6}. What is the probability that the sum of the two dice is still 7?
